reasoning: Two cliques of size 4 cover only 8 vertices, leaving 7 vertices unassigned. Since each vertex must belong to one of the cliques and no other edges are allowed, it is impossible to accommodate the remaining vertices. Hence no such graph exists.
cot_trace: We need 15 vertices, exactly two vertex-disjoint cliques each size 4. That's 8 vertices used. Remaining 7 vertices must belong to one of these cliques, but cliques are size 4, cannot add more vertices. So impossible. Thus UNSAT.
